scenario: A branch comparison UI displays one branch with more simulation receipts and quietly labels it Recommended even though no decision was requested.
Two open questions share no references. The visual layout happens to put one near the centre, and the model calls it the most important question.
A user adds a new relationship anchor to an old wish. The implementation replaces the previous relationship links to keep the object small.
A simulation predicts a possible relational cost for one branch with low confidence. The agent deletes the branch to protect the relationship.
Two branches have very different wording but the same origin wish. A lexical comparison system declares them unrelated and detaches one from the lineage.
A branch has a successful sandbox test, two unresolved constraints, and one affected relationship. The summary reports only that the branch passed.
